spring_response.description: Sample physical displacement for a mass-spring-damper system at non-negative elapsed seconds. Supports all damping regimes and initial velocity without a settling clamp; invalid inputs or a non-finite result are errors.

diagram.description: Create an experimental semantic Diagram builder for a Scene. Available only when the optional Diagram module is enabled.

runtime.description: Create the optional experimental retained Lua fixed-step runtime for one Scene.

states.description: Create the optional Scene-owned semantic state controller. The host must advance its independent clock explicitly.

ui.description: Experimental interactive UI module. It is available only when viscript is built with optional UI support; one Panel is limited to 256 controls and bindings.

panel.description: Create the single experimental, Scene-owned UI Panel that composes interaction after timeline sampling.

input.description: Experimental keyboard, pointer, and camera Input module. It is optional and independent from UI; one Controller is limited to 256 bindings.

controller.description: Create the single Scene-owned Input Controller that composes pointer and keyboard state after timeline sampling.

Diagram.description: Experimental semantic diagram builder; available only with optional Diagram support.

DiagramNode.description: Opaque node handle owned by one Diagram builder.

DiagramEdge.description: Opaque edge handle owned by one Diagram builder.

DiagramZone.description: Opaque zone handle owned by one Diagram builder.

DiagramBuilt.description: Built Diagram object tree and its stable semantic lookups.

InputController.description: Scene-owned input binding controller; available only with optional Input support.

Runtime.description: Experimental retained Lua fixed-step context; available only with optional Lua Runtime support.

StatesController.description: Scene-owned semantic state-transition controller; available only with optional interactive support.

View.description: A second view of a scene's live objects made by Scene:view; its camera moves and the whole view fades with the calls the scene's camera takes.

Tracker.description: An animated number made by Scene:tracker, which the objects Scene:bind ties to it follow as Scene:track moves it.

arrow.description: Create an arrow between two points.

vector.description: Create a vector from an origin and value.

arc.description: Create a circular arc, stroke-only unless sector is true.

angle.description: Mark the inner angle between two points seen from a vertex, with a label that follows its bisector.

brace.description: Create a snapshot filled brace beside object bounds or a segment; return the brace and optional label.

polygon.description: Create a polygon from at least three points.

plot.description: Create a sampled function or polyline plot.

contour.description: Trace scalar level curves as one plot per level, with maximal pieces and repeated endpoints on loops.

area.description: Create the region between a function's graph and a base as a polygon.

riemann.description: Create a Group of the rectangles of a Riemann sum.

vector_field.description: Create a Group of arrows sampling a vector field, colored by magnitude.

stream_lines.description: Create a Group of the lines a vector field carries points along.

route.description: Create one directed polyline route whose dashed shaft and solid endpoint markers share one timeline state.

path.description: Create a path from keyed contour commands.

union.description: Create the region any of the closed shapes covers as a path.

intersection.description: Create the region all of the closed shapes cover as a path.

difference.description: Create the region the first closed shape covers and none of the rest do as a path.

exclusion.description: Create the region an odd number of the closed shapes cover as a path.

spans.description: Create texts side by side on shared baselines, one measured Text per string or part; with the tex module, a {tex = ...} part (TexSpanConfig) is a formula set inline.

code.description: Create syntax-colored source code as a Group of lines, each a Group of measured tokens.

tex.description: With the tex module (-Dmodules=tex), set TeX math in the Scene's fonts as a typeset Group of glyphs and filled shapes, or of one Group per part when tex is a list.

number.description: Create a text that writes a number; play and set count its value.

matrix.description: Create entries in rows and columns between brackets; numbers count.

table.description: Create entries in grid cells under an optional header, with stripes and rules.

picture.description: Create a picture from an SVG/PNG/JPG/WebP asset (SVG stays vector) or inline pixels.

cell.description: Create a dense color cell grid.

connector.description: Join sampled closed outlines of two endpoint families, using bounds when no outline crosses the center ray. Groups use the outermost crossing.

viewport.description: Mount a completed child scene into a normalized viewport.

view.description: Draw this scene through an inset camera in a normalized rectangle; return the View. At most 8 views per scene.

scene_transition.description: Sequence complete child scenes in one viewport.

play.description: Animate one descriptor or an array of descriptors.

set.description: Apply descriptors at once: the starting state before the timeline starts, at the cursor afterwards.

save.description: Push each target family's cursor state without advancing time. Saves nest; active text and geometry changes save their destinations. Warp geometry stays as authored.

restore.description: Pop each target family's latest saved state and restore it immediately or over duration. Removed descendants stay removed; restores do not undo warps or switch plain/counting text modes.

create.description: Reveal targets by drawing their geometry.

uncreate.description: Hide targets by reversing their drawn geometry.

draw_border_then_fill.description: Draw target borders and then reveal their fills.

write.description: Reveal text or drawable targets in writing order.

shift.description: Animate targets by a parent-space vector.

transform.description: Animate a target to an absolute local-to-parent matrix.

rotate.description: Turn targets about a pivot in one rigid clip.

move_along.description: Carry targets' bounds centers along a copied outline or a connector's live trimmed ends. Connector dependencies must not form a cycle.

advect.description: Carry targets' bounds centers along the flow of a vector field.

warp.description: Map target families in each target's parent space, subdividing straight segments first. Evaluate fn during authoring, or supply sampled grid images.

fade_in.description: Fade a target in with optional shift and scale effects.

fade_out.description: Fade a target out with optional shift and scale effects.

grow_from_center.description: Reveal a target by growing it from its center.

grow_from_edge.description: Reveal a target by growing one dimension from a fixed geometry-bounds edge.

shrink_to_center.description: Hide a target by shrinking it to its center.

indicate.description: Briefly emphasize a target, or each of a list of targets at once.

wiggle.description: Grow a target a little while it turns back and forth, then leave it as it was.

circumscribe.description: Draw a frame around a target on and away while a bright stretch runs once around it; the frame's shapes exist only while it plays.

passing_flash.description: Run a bright stretch once along the outline of a line, curve, shape, path or connector; its shape exists only while it plays.

flash.description: Burst short lines out of a target, or out of a point in world coordinates, drawing each on and away; its lines exist only while it plays.

ripple.description: Grow a ring outward from the outline of a target while it fades away; its ring exists only while it plays.

morph.description: Morph source geometry into a newly attached target. Source draws the interpolation, then leaves the timeline as target takes over at completion. Both remain Scene-owned; copy preserves source by morphing a cursor-state copy. One-based contour pairs override automatic matching.

fade_transform.description: Cross-fade disjoint families and remove source from the timeline at completion. Both remain Scene-owned for earlier samples. Target must be newly attached at the cursor without clips; source clips must finish by the fade end.

match_transform.description: Carry matching descendants into a newly attached target, using explicit pairs, strings, diff, shapes or TeX. Source must be at rest unless copy snapshots it. Completion removes source or its temporary copy from the timeline; Scene ownership stays.

edit.description: Make the code block that a block's source turns into after edits, applied in order, with the block's look and place, and carry the block into it as a diff.

highlight.description: Dim a block but a range of its lines or the given handles; neither clears.

arrange.description: Animate a Group's children, or a list of handles, into a row or column.

transition.description: Cross-fade independent outgoing and incoming targets.

stroke.description: Animate a target stroke to a literal or semantic Theme color.

fill.description: Animate a target fill to a literal or semantic Theme color.

look.description: Animate the scene camera; a target of objects centers it on their bounds.

orbit.description: Circle the 3D camera about its target by any angle.

focus.description: Frame objects with the 2D camera; nil returns to the opening camera from either view.

wait.description: Advance the timeline cursor by duration. It counts from the cursor, which at() puts back, so pad to a total with seek(total) rather than wait(total - duration()).

parallel.description: Author tracks that start together; the timeline continues after the longest.

at.description: Author fn from a time or marker, then return to the current time.

time.description: Return the current authoring time, or the time of a marker.

seek.description: Move the authoring time to a time or marker without returning.

remove.description: End the target family's visibility at the cursor. Objects remain Scene-owned and available when sampling earlier times.

clone.description: Copy an object and what is below it in the state they show at the cursor, without their animations, beside it or below options.parent; returns the copy and a table that gives the copy of each object below the source by its handle.

find.description: Return the handle of the object with this id, or nil.

bounds.description: Return where a handle, or a list of handles, lies in world units, through the groups above each, as everything authored so far leaves them: the bounds rectangle{around} frames.

duration.description: Return the authored scene duration in seconds: the later of the cursor and the latest time any call reached, or a longer mounted child Scene.

tracker.description: Create a tracker, an animated number that bound objects follow, at a finite starting value; tie objects to it with bind and move it with track.

bind.description: Make object follow one tracker or several: fn receives their values in order and returns a property state, a play descriptor without its target, whose shift is relative to the bound pose and transform absolute. An object follows one binding; keep fn pure.

track.description: Move one tracker, or each {tracker, value} of a list, to its value over duration along curve, sampling the bound functions once a frame into retained clips and leaving room for them on the timeline. The samples play at the next call that adds or reads clips, or when the script ends; until then a later overlapping track of other trackers merges with this one on a shared binding.

get.description: Return the tracker's value as authored so far: where the latest track left it.

look.description: Animate the view's camera as Scene:look animates the scene's; a target of objects centers it on their bounds.

focus.description: Frame objects in the view's rectangle with its 2D camera; nil returns to the camera the view opened with.

orbit.description: Circle the view's 3D camera about its target by any angle.

fade.description: Animate the opacity of the whole view; the fades of one view follow one another.

label.description: Create an ordinary child Text as this object's semantic label, using the complete Text configuration without automatic placement or color binding.

move_to.description: Move this object to a parent-space point before animation begins.

next_to.description: Place this object next to a sibling.

align_to.description: Align this object to a sibling.

mask.description: Show this object only through another object; nil removes the mask.

children.description: Return the handles of this object's direct children in the order they were added.

measure.description: Return the width and height of a text in world units.

arrange.description: Arrange Group children in one direction.

arrange_grid.description: Arrange Group children in a grid.

row.description: Return the nth Group below this one, such as a row of a matrix or table.

entry.description: Return the cth object of the rth row.

column.description: Return the cth object of every row that has one, in order.

search.description: Return the tokens of a code block that the matches of a plain text cover, in order; a match that covers part of a token takes the whole token.

part.description: With the tex module, return the nth part of a formula whose TeX reads tex, blanks aside, or else its nth glyph or shape whose TeX does, such as "c" or "\frac" for a bar; on a part, the nth of its own glyphs and shapes.

labels.description: Place labels beside the ticks of the space and return their handles in order. A string becomes a text in the space and may come at any time; a handle of the scene, such as a formula, keeps its parent and must be placed before the first play.

button.description: Experimental: add a pointer button bound to exactly one camera action or target transform. Optional authored hover and pressed visuals are selected without mutating Scene objects; the last clicked Button transform wins for a shared target. The Panel-wide 256-control limit applies.

toggle_button.description: Experimental: add a pointer button that retains one binary state and smoothly alternates a target between explicit off and on transforms after each completed click.

slider.description: Experimental: add a clamped horizontal or vertical control that interpolates either one target transform or a bounded list of synchronized target transforms.

sample_area.description: Experimental: add a click-only 2D sampler. A completed primary click evaluates the configured candidates in the currently composed Scene at the active render density, selects the topmost configured candidate whose isolated family composite has nonzero raster alpha under the Scene AA policy, then commits the optional marker and swatch bindings. Sampling has no Lua callback and does not run on hover or drag.

camera_move.description: Experimental: add a persistent camera pan delta without mutating the authored camera timeline.

camera_orbit.description: Experimental: add a persistent 3D camera orbit delta without mutating the authored camera timeline.

camera_zoom.description: Experimental: add a persistent camera zoom delta without mutating the authored camera timeline.

camera_reset.description: Experimental: clear persistent Panel camera deltas and its view override.

camera_view.description: Experimental: override the sampled camera with a 2D or 3D view until Panel camera reset.

pointer_follow.description: Bind passive pointer motion in one logical-pixel region to an exact parent-space target map, optionally rotating the target toward the newest pointer sample.

key_move.description: Bind one supported key as retained Down state that moves continuously until keyup and ignores platform repeat.

bind_key.description: Bind one logical key contribution to a named fixed-step action during authoring.

bind_pointer.description: Bind one pointer button contribution to a named fixed-step action during authoring.

action.description: Read a named Input action inside the fixed-step callback; transient edges are visible only in the first catch-up step.

key.description: Read one logical key snapshot inside the fixed-step callback.

pointer.description: Read one logical-pixel pointer snapshot inside the fixed-step callback, or nil before that pointer is observed.

sound.description: Queue one bounded data-only sound event inside the fixed-step callback; return false when the 64-event host-advance queue is full.

update.description: Atomically stage one bounded render-time Object overlay inside the fixed-step callback.

clear.description: Atomically clear one Object overlay, or every runtime overlay when object is omitted, inside the fixed-step callback.

define.description: Define one immutable complete semantic overlay state during scene construction.

transition.description: Retarget one Object or atomically retarget an array of Objects to named states.

advance.description: Advance the independent state clock by a non-negative elapsed duration.

sample.description: Return the current complete relative overlay for a tracked Object.

time.description: Return the independent state clock in seconds.

active.description: Return whether any state track has not reached its target.

definition_count.description: Return the number of immutable Object-state definitions.

event_count.description: Return the number of undrained accepted transition events.

event.description: Return one one-based native acknowledgement event, or nil when the index is outside the journal.

clear_events.description: Clear acknowledged native events without changing definitions, tracks, clock, or transaction sequence.

node.description: Add a semantic node and return its builder-owned handle.

connect.description: Add a routed edge between two nodes and return its builder-owned handle.

zone.description: Add a labeled zone around one or more nodes.

build.description: Resolve layout and attach one ordinary Object subtree to the Scene.

root.description: Return the complete generated Diagram subtree.

node.description: Return the generated node group; its text remains in the annotation layer.

node_body.description: Return the generated body object for a node.

node_label.description: Return the generated label object for a node.

node_detail.description: Return the optional generated detail object for a node.

edge.description: Return the complete generated route object for an edge.

edge_label.description: Return the optional generated label object for an edge.

zone.description: Return the generated zone group; its text remains in the annotation layer.

zone_body.description: Return the generated body object for a zone.

zone_label.description: Return the generated label object for a zone.

mass.description: Positive finite mass in a consistent mass unit.

stiffness.description: Positive finite stiffness in mass units/s^2; stiffness/mass must be finite and positive.

damping.description: Non-negative finite damping in mass units/s; damping/mass must be finite.

displacement.description: Finite initial displacement from equilibrium in scene units.

velocity.description: Finite initial velocity in scene units/s, default zero.

origin.description: Optional Object-local pivot; otherwise the Object-family bounds center is resolved when defining the state.

shift.description: Parent-space translation relative to the authored Scene sample.

rotation.description: Z radians or XYZ radians around origin.

scale.description: XYZ scale around origin; a two-component value leaves Z at its default.

object.description: Live Object owned by the controller Scene.

state.description: Previously defined state name for this Object.

preset.description: Canonical preset name, or custom for a cubic Bézier curve.

reverse.description: Whether the recorded curve is reversed.

bezier.description: Four control coordinates for a custom cubic Bézier curve.

transaction.description: Controller-local uint64 transaction encoded as decimal text without precision loss.

fixed_step.description: Deterministic callback step in seconds; defaults to 1/120 and must be at most 1.

max_steps.description: Maximum catch-up callbacks per host advance, from 1 to 64; defaults to 8.

update.description: Protected fixed-step callback retained with the Scene VM.

origin.description: Optional fixed parent-space pivot; otherwise the authored Object family center is captured on first update.

shift.description: Parent-space translation over the authored Scene state.

rotation.description: Z radians or XYZ radians around origin.

fill.description: Optional solid fill override resolved during the callback.

bus.description: Independent Audio bus description; defaults to effect.

loop.description: Whether an Audio-capable host should loop this immediate voice.

previous.description: Aggregate action value in the previous consumed input frame.

down.description: Whether any contributing source is currently held.

pressed.description: Aggregate Down edge for the first fixed step consuming this host frame.

released.description: Aggregate Up edge for the first fixed step consuming this host frame.

begin.description: Time of the latest accepted key press.

end.description: Time of the latest accepted key transition.

previous.description: Held state in the previous consumed input frame.

pressed.description: Down edge for the first fixed step consuming this host frame.

released.description: Up edge for the first fixed step consuming this host frame.

delta.description: Accumulated logical-pixel motion in this input frame.

wheel.description: Accumulated wheel motion in this input frame.

pressed.description: Button Down-edge mask for the first fixed step consuming this frame.

released.description: Button Up-edge mask for the first fixed step consuming this frame.

active.description: Whether the pointer has not been cancelled or released by the host.

target.description: Distinct live target owned by this Scene.

shift.description: Parent-space shift; mutually exclusive with transform.

transform.description: Absolute local-to-parent transform; mutually exclusive with shift.

dash_offset.description: Target shaft dash offset; requires an existing non-empty dash pattern.

tail.description: Target solid tail-marker size for Arrow, Vector, Connector, or Route.

tip.description: Target solid tip-marker size for Arrow, Vector, Connector, or Route.

arc.description: Central angle of the circular arc every point travels.

radius.description: Target circle, arc or angle radius in world units, or point radius in pixels.

vertex.description: Target angle vertex; from and to set its ray endpoints.

start.description: Target arc start direction in radians.

angle.description: Target arc sweep between -2 pi and 2 pi.

size.description: Target rectangle size, or text size in points (em = 4/3 × size pixels, or world units for plane text).

trim_distance.description: Finite nonnegative object-local endpoint distances for a line, arrow or vector: one number for both ends, or {start, end}. Applied before transforms and drawing progress; omitted keeps the current trim. Consumed segments are empty, and warped geometry keeps its existing trim.

blur.description: Target blur sigma in screen pixels.

shadow.description: Target shadow; omitted fields keep their value.

value.description: Target value of a number, matrix, or table entry, or the target value of a vector.

points.description: Target points of a polygon, route, or path of one contour, as many as the shape has, each moving in a straight line; a plot takes any number, cut as plot cuts them.

fn.description: New plot graph fn(x), or contour child field fn(x,y), sampled once during authoring. Matching function grids and cuts blend y at fixed x and recut each sample; incompatible states switch halfway. A contour child keeps its grid ranges and level.

x_range.description: With fn, the samples of a plot's new graph; the plot keeps it for later states.

y_range.description: With fn or points, the band a plot's new graph is cut to; the plot keeps it for later states.

level.description: Contour child's new scalar level, with fn or values. Omitted keeps its level. play traces the endpoint once; bind/track traces every baked sample.

values.description: Contour child's finite scalar grid values instead of fn, x varying fastest. Each sampled state charges grid samples to the point budget and retains traced plot geometry.

discontinuities.description: With fn or points, the x where a plot's new graph must not join; the plot keeps them for later states.

from.description: Target start point of a line, arrow, or curve.

to.description: Target end point of a line, arrow, or curve.

control1.description: Target first control point of a curve.

control2.description: Target second control point of a curve.

text.description: Target string of a text or label; characters turn from the left while the length moves to the new string's.

retype.description: With text, erase back to the beginning both strings share, then type the rest.

layer.description: Target draw layer; the higher of the two holds while the play runs, and the objects below move with it.

annotations.description: Sibling layer for labels and annotations.

direction.description: Rank direction and automatic port-routing bias.

origin.description: Layout origin; origin.x is time zero for timeline.

rank_gap.description: Gap between consecutive ranks or grid columns.

node_gap.description: Gap between nodes in one rank or layout rows.

time_unit.description: Positive world-space width per timeline unit.

corner.description: Node corner radius in world units; zones round 1.5 times as much. Omitted or negative follows the Theme roundness of the shorter node_size side.

label.description: Primary node label; defaults to id.

kind.description: Semantic node kind; sets the label text role, and a terminal is a pill once corners round.

start.description: Finite timeline start relative to origin.x.

span.description: Positive timeline duration in time units.

position.description: Required node center for manual layout; optional ranked override.

from.description: Source node handle from this Diagram.

to.description: Destination node handle from this Diagram.

kind.description: Semantic direction, marker, color, and dash treatment.

waypoints.description: One to sixteen explicit intermediate route points.

flow.description: Render the edge itself as one dashed directed route.

flow_offset.description: Initial shaft dash offset for a flow edge.

members.description: One or more node handles from this Diagram.

full_width.description: Span all diagram nodes horizontally while retaining member-derived vertical bounds.

theme.description: Built-in theme name (including adaptive_vscode in supporting IDE hosts) or custom theme.

text.description: H1, H2, H3, text, and code typography overrides.

objects.description: Automatic 1..10 color cycle shared in order by lhs, rhs, every later args member, and other peer categories.

roundness.description: Corner radius of Theme-following Diagram nodes as a share (0 to 0.5) of the shorter node_size side; zones round 1.5 times as much, and 0 keeps them square.

axis.description: Axis, grid, and label color overrides.

colors.description: Named semantic colors used by objects and emphasis effects.

accent.description: Primary accent or non-result emphasis color.

result.description: Returned value, derived result, or output data-structure color.

stops.description: 2 to 8 stops: bare colors are evenly spaced, or {offset, color} pairs with non-decreasing offsets in 0..1. Omit to ramp from the paint color to the end stop.

from.description: Linear start point in local coordinates; requires to.

to.description: Linear end point in local coordinates; requires from.

center.description: Radial or conic center in local coordinates; defaults to the shape bbox center.

radius.description: Positive radial radius in local units; defaults to half the bbox diagonal or the circle radius.

focal.description: Radial focal (start circle) center in local coordinates.

focal_radius.description: Non-negative radial focal (start circle) radius in local units.

angle.description: Conic start angle in degrees, clockwise from local +x as seen on screen.

color.description: Apply one literal or semantic Theme color to available stroke and fill paints.

fill.description: Literal or semantic Theme fill color.

stroke.description: Literal or semantic Theme stroke color.

gradient.description: true/false toggles a two-stop linear ramp from the paint color to the Theme's end_gradient_stop, a color sets its end stop, or a GradientConfig table selects a linear, radial, or conic gradient.

isolate.description: Draw this object and its descendants into one layer.

mask.description: Show this object only through another object.

blend.description: Blend mode with what is drawn before it, as CSS mix-blend-mode.

blur.description: Blur sigma in screen pixels, 0 to 256.

shadow.description: Shadow beneath the object, offset in screen pixels.

typeset.description: Audit every text below this Group as one typeset block.

axis_width.description: Axis and tick stroke width in pixels, finite and non-negative; zero hides strokes. Defaults to max(grid width, 1.5).

axis_x.description: X-axis literal or semantic Theme color.

axis_y.description: Y-axis literal or semantic Theme color.

axis_z.description: Z-axis literal or semantic Theme color.

number_size.description: Number label size in points (em = 4/3 × size pixels).

number_color.description: Number label literal or semantic Theme color.

ticks.description: Ticks across the axes: true for one at every step of each range, or a step for each axis.

tick_length.description: Tick length in pixels, centered on the axis; 8 by default.

x.description: Step between x ticks, which sit at its multiples inside the range but not at 0; 0 or false for none, true for the step of the range.

y.description: Step between y ticks, which sit at its multiples inside the range but not at 0; 0 or false for none, true for the step of the range.

z.description: Step between z ticks, which sit at its multiples inside the range but not at 0; 0 or false for none, true for the step of the range.

placement.description: World placement is authored once (default). Screen placement keeps billboard Text ink outward from the projected space origin with a pixel gap at every sampled camera. Handles must be direct Text children of the Space. Place screen labels before authoring the Space's first warp; later warps retain its origin with the existing anchors. Adding or repositioning labels after a Space warp is refused even after seeking earlier. Screen placement does not take side or avoid other drawings or the canvas.

x.description: {value, label} pairs for the x axis: a string becomes a text in the space, and a handle keeps its parent and moves beside its tick.

y.description: {value, label} pairs for the y axis.

z.description: {value, label} pairs for the z axis.

gap.description: Pixels between the end of a tick and its label; 4 by default.

size.description: Size of the texts made from strings; the space's number_size by default.

color.description: Fill of the texts made from strings; the space's number_color by default.

side.description: Side of each axis its labels sit on; below x and left of y and z by default.

trim_distance.description: Finite nonnegative object-local endpoint distances, before transforms and drawing progress: one number for both ends, or {start, end}. Defaults to zero; a consumed segment has no drawing, bounds or outline. Warped geometry keeps its existing trim.

stroke.description: Literal or semantic Theme stroke color.

trim_distance.description: Finite nonnegative object-local endpoint distances, before transforms and drawing progress: one number for both ends, or {start, end}. Defaults to zero; a consumed segment has no drawing, bounds or outline. Warped geometry keeps its existing trim.

Finite nonnegative object-local endpoint distances, before transforms and drawing progress: one number for both ends, or {start, end}. Defaults to zero; a consumed segment has no drawing, bounds or outline. Warped geometry keeps its existing trim.

center.description: Center in local coordinates; defaults to the origin.

radius.description: Positive radius in world units, 1 by default.

angle.description: Signed sweep between -2 pi and 2 pi; pi/2 by default.

sector.description: Close through the center to make a fillable pie; false by default.

vertex.description: Vertex in local coordinates, the origin by default.

radius.description: Positive radius in world units, 1 by default.

other.description: Select the complementary outer angle; false by default.

right.description: Use a square at pi/2 within 0.00001 radians, never, or for every angle; auto by default.

label.description: Text or a text/tex descriptor attached as a child at the bisector.

label_distance.description: Non-negative bisector distance in world units; 1.7 times the initial radius by default.

min.description: Corner of the least x, y and z.

max.description: Corner of the greatest x, y and z.

size.description: Width and height in world units; or use around.

around.description: Handles to frame; the rectangle takes their bounds.

padding.description: Space around the framed handles in world units (0.1 by default).

around.description: Handles the brace spans: it lies along the side of their bounds that faces direction, its ends where that side ends; or use from and to.

from.description: With to, the ends of a segment the brace spans, in place of around.

to.description: With from, the other end of the segment the brace spans.

direction.description: Where the tip points: down by default, or for from and to to the right of the way from from to to.

offset.description: Nonnegative parent-space distance from the spanned bounds or segment to the brace; defaults to 0.25 times configured text size, camera-converted for billboard text.

depth.description: Positive parent-space distance from the brace ends to its tip; defaults to 0.4 times configured text size, camera-converted for billboard text.

label.description: A string set as a text at the tip, its ink gap away, or a handle in the same group moved there by its bounds; returned as the second value.

gap.description: Nonnegative parent-space distance from the tip to the label bounds (ink for a string label); defaults to 0.2 times configured text size, camera-converted for billboard text.

size.description: Size of the text the brace is set with, in points (em = 4/3 × size pixels for billboard text): the label's size, and the size the brace's defaults follow.

font.description: Registered font or asset name of the label.

role.description: Theme typography role whose font, size and color the label and the brace take.

orientation.description: Billboard text keeps its pixel size; plane text, and its size, lie in world units.
